page.overview:
What is Beirut Cabaret?

This unnamed cabaret / nightclub in Beirut, Lebanon is the first destination during Bond's hunt for Francisco Scaramanga. Five years before the events of The Man with the Golden Gun, in 1969, Scaramanga murdered agent 002, Bill Fairbanks in this location.

In order to retrieve a bullet to get a lead on Scaramanga, Bond travels to Beirut and contacts Saida, a belly dancer who was with Fairbanks, when he was shot. The club is owned by the Lebanese Club Boss, who dislikes Bond making contact with Saida.

After a heavy fistfight, Bond leaves the club's backstage area and gets into a taxi.
